review_questions: Independently falsify the web-first TESTING→RELEASE_CANDIDATE→PRODUCTION promotion boundary. Assume false-green and do not treat PB-01..PB-16 green CI as sufficient evidence.

Verify build-once/promote-same-artifact semantics are deterministic and cannot be bypassed by same-SHA rebuilds, artifact substitution, head drift, environment-label substitution, reviewer/model claims, or stale evidence.
Verify production authorization is separate from release-candidate qualification and that non-production credential domains cannot satisfy production eligibility.
Verify rollback is limited to previously production-authorized artifacts and that replay/rebinding behavior fails closed.
Check CI run 34269085847 is bound to exact candidate bb2a591d6fa9d6da507d6ff6aa8f444784a57651 and PB-01..PB-16 executed.

Search for missing identity bindings, canonical-digest ambiguity, authorization replay/rebinding, expiry edge cases, environment confusion, rollback bypasses, and claims that exceed the reference gate.
Return PASS only if every mandatory dimension is TESTED_SUPPORTED and no MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL finding remains.

evidence_refs.ref: Slice5 merged cleanly to main at f67e0dfb4fe9b4bb67c76dbd43f1485861c96fc0. This new boundary is a separate production-readiness phase and has no production authority yet.

required_review_dimensions.description: Exact candidate is the four-file web-first promotion-boundary change based on merged Slice5 main and does not itself deploy or provision production.
Source SHA and immutable artifact digest remain exactly bound across testing, release candidate and production; same-SHA rebuild substitution is denied.
Testing, review, adjudication and build provenance evidence are exact-candidate/artifact bound and stale or incomplete evidence fails closed.
Direct TESTING→PRODUCTION and environment-label substitution are impossible; RELEASE_CANDIDATE is a mandatory intermediate state.
Release-candidate qualification does not itself grant production eligibility; exact production authorization is separately required and validated.
Non-production credential domain, reviewer PASS, model claims and workflow labels cannot manufacture production authority.
Exact replay is deterministic while promotion/authorization rebinding, head drift, malformed/expired authorization fail closed.
Rollback target must be a previously valid production-authorized artifact and arbitrary historical artifacts are denied.
CI run 34269085847 is bound to exact candidate and the 16 adversarial cases genuinely test the frozen invariants rather than only labels.

The implementation claims only deterministic promotion-policy authority and does not imply real production environment, hosting, secret manager, deployment runtime or security; adversarial review finds no material bypass.
